newsitem.title: UK: Horlick meets lawyer on MGAM.
newsitem.headline: Horlick meets lawyer on MGAM.

text.p: Former Morgan Grenfell Asset management fund manager Nicola Horlick arrived at her lawyer's office on Tuesday for further meetings, a spokeswoman for law firm Herbert Smith said.

Horlick spent most of Monday with her lawyer John Farr in a bid to gain reinstatement or compensation after she quit her one million stg job with the 18 billion stg pension fund arm of Deutsche Bank's investment banking unit Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.

Horlick's adviser said she was waiting to see what would emerge from Deutsche's investigation into the affair which Horlick claims she was promised would take place after her visit to Frankfurt last Friday.
Deutsche and DMG have since made it clear that any investigation into the affair is the reponsibility of DMG management in London.
DMG last week suspended Horlick alleging that she was about to defect to a rival firm. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
